reuse.why: Adds the closed-account check to the existing pre-link guard that all six provider link functions already call.

duplication.why: The check is written once; the provider functions only had the guard renamed.

placement.why: The guard is renamed to assertCanLinkBankAccount so its name matches its broader responsibility, and it stays in accounts/app.ts next to the link handlers.

scope.why: The rename and the new check are both needed for the rule; tests are focused on it.

maintainability.why: One clearly named precondition function covers every provider, which makes the rule easy to find and extend.

one_place.where: assertCanLinkBankAccount in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by every link*Account handler.
